Harper (People Ops): Quick heads-up  walk-in partner arriving at 3:10. Theyll be in for a 3:30 show-and-tell. Can someone grab a spare visitor badge and set up the small table by the sunroof?
Ivy: I can grab the sunroof table. Also we have a tiny bike-box parcel that looks like its for Maya  saw label 'BIKE-PROTO' at reception.
Ethan: Ill sort badges. FYI badge printer sometimes outputs blank backs; quick fix is `badge-cli reset && badge-cli print --single`.
FrontDesk-Bot: New prereg: "Pilot - Tanaka"  status: PENDING_PRINT.
Courier (UPS): Parcel delivered 14:22  "BIKE-PROTO"  left at reception.
Maya: Thats mine, thanks courier. Ill collect at 2:45.
Harper (People Ops): Seating poll  sunroof table (light) vs comfy sofa (cozy). Guests are staying ~30m.
Ivy: Sunroof table for quick demos.
Ethan: Agreed. Table set. Also shoutout to Maya for dropping off extra cable adapters yesterday  saved the demo setup. :raised_hands:
Maya: Aw thanks! No problem.
FrontDesk-Bot: Badge printer status: TEST_OK at 14:53.
Harper (People Ops): Perfect. If the printer hiccups, well use clip-on paper badges and mark as VISITOR.
Ethan: Printer test passed. Badges printed for 3 guests and one staff.
Ivy: Sunroof table in place, plant moved from lobby to table. Looks cheery.
Maya: Picked up bike-box. Marked fragile. All set.
Harper (People Ops): Thanks team. Meeting scheduled and room prepped. Closing thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
